episodeTitle.en: Seth Godin's best tactics for building remarkable products, strategies, brands and more
episodeTitle.zh: 赛斯·戈丁（Seth Godin）打造卓越产品、战略、品牌等的绝佳策略

guestBioOfficial.en: Seth Godin is a legend. He’s a marketer, teacher, entrepreneur, and author of more than 20 books, including Purple Cow, Permission Marketing, and Linchpin. He also writes one of the most popular and longest-running blogs in the world (approaching publishing 10,000 in a row!) and continues to shape how we think about marketing, brand, product, and creating lasting change in the world. In our conversation, we discuss: • How to build remarkable products that spread
guestBioOfficial.zh: 赛斯·戈丁（Seth Godin）堪称传奇人物。他既是营销专家、教育者，也是《紫牛》《许可营销》《支点》等20余部著作的作者。他还运营着全球最受欢迎且持续更新的博客（已连续发布近万篇文章！），持续重塑我们对营销、品牌、产品以及如何在世界上创造持久变革的认知。在对话中，我们探讨了：• 如何打造能自我传播的卓越产品

summary.en: This episode explores how to build remarkable products that spread, create a strategy with productive tension, make a meaningful promise to users, and build brands that remain distinctive as AI becomes ubiquitous.
summary.zh: 本期围绕如何打造值得主动传播的产品、如何让策略保有有效张力、如何向用户作出并兑现一个有意义的承诺，以及当 AI 逐渐成为基础能力后，品牌怎样继续保持差异化展开。
